enzyme

This enzyme
catalyses
the following
chemical reaction
geranyl diphosphate
⇌
{\displaystyle \rightleftharpoons }
(+)-car-3-ene +
diphosphate
The enzyme reacts with (3
S
)-linalyl diphosphate twice as rapidly as geranyl diphosphate.
